description: This file defines the MessageBuilder interface, a fluent API for constructing immutable Message objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.messages package. It includes methods for setting payloads, headers, extra data, and response consumers, as well as static methods for creating header builders.

classes.name: MessageBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for an immutable Message, parameterized by payload type T.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Static method to create a new MessageHeadersBuilder with deprecated overload accepting CharSequence for thingId, and current overload accepting ThingId.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Sets the payload of the message.

methods.name: rawPayload
methods.description: Sets the raw ByteBuffer payload of the message.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Sets additional JSON data for the message.

methods.name: responseConsumer
methods.description: Adds a response consumer to be stored with the message, not serialized.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable Message instance with the set properties.
